Mritunjay Dixit And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7
May, 2025
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:74185
Court No. - 73
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 535 of 2025
Applicant :- Mritunjay Dixit And 6 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rahul Kumar Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

Heard Sri Rahul Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicants as well as Sri Kripa Shankar,
learned Aga for the State.

2.  In view of the order which is being proposed to be passed, notice is not being issued to the opposite party no. 2.
3.

The case of the applicant is that a complaint was lodged by the opposite party no. 2, wife, on 23.08.2022 under Sections 498A, 313, 323, 504, 506 IPC read with Section 3/4 of the DP Act against the applicants who are seven in number, husband, father-in-law, mother-in-law, uncle father-in-law, brother-in-law, sister-in-law and also brother-in-law with an allegation that the marriage of the opposite party no. 2 stood solemnized with the applicant no. 1 on 25.02.2020.
Allegations has also been levelled regarding demand of dowry and cruelty.

Learned counsel for the applicant has invited the attention of the Court towards Annexure-3 at page 27 of the paper book Mritunjay Dixit And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59681433/
1 being statement of the complainant under Section 200 Cr.P.C. followed by Annexure-4 at page 33,
the statement of PW 1 Ravindra Nath Pandey, P.W. 2 Smt. Madhuri Pandey, page 41 and PW 3 Ravi Thakur at page 47.
4.

entities.text: Mritunjay Dixit And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that on 20.01.2023 the applicants have been summoned under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC read with Section 3/4 of DP Act, however, the court below had taken into consideration the statements recorded under Section 200 and 202 of Cr.P.C. of Mritunjay Dixit, Parsuram Dixit, Smt. Vidyawati Dixit, Shishu Pal Dixit, Mithilesh Dixit, Smt.
Vandana Dubey and Bharat Dubey.
Learned counsel for the applicants, thus, submits that they were not the witnesses and there is no question of the statements being taken into consideration of Section 200 and 202 Cr.P.C.
He submits that the court below has not applied its mind and summoned the applicants without even considering the statements of the actual witnesses under Section 200 and 202.
He, thus, submits that the summoning order be set aside, matter be remitted back to the court below to pass a fresh order.

5. Learned AGA, on the other hand, could not dispute the said fact according to him, it appears that either there is a typographical error or the statements in respect of different case has been taken note.
6. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record carefully.

7. Though, as a matter of routine, the courts are not required to throttle the investigation at the stage of trial, however, once, there is a fundamental defect in the summoning order and it proceeds on fundamental defect then, obviously the Court, in order to rectify the said mistake, is required to interfere with the summoning order.

Apparently, from the certified copies so annexed, the statements under Section 200 was of Shikha Pandey and Section 202 of Ravindra Nath Pandey,
Smt. Madhuri Pandey and Sri Ravi Thakur, however, the summoning order recites that the statements of Mritunjay Dixit, Parsuram Dixit, Smt. Vidyawati Dixit, Shishu Pal Dixit, Mithilesh Dixit, Smt. Vandana Dubey and Bharat Dubey have been considered.
Since, as per the records, they were not the witnesses, thus, there was no question of consideration of their statement.

8. Accordingly, considering the entire facts situation, the summoning order dated 20.01.2023 passed in Complaint Case No. 44714 of 2022 is set aside, matter stands remitted back to the court below to pass a fresh order strictly in accordance with law.

For facilitating the disposal of the present proceedings, the applicants shall file a certified copy of the order passed today before the court below by 16.05.2025.
9.
With the above observation, the application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 7.5.2025
